items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: Just like the Eureka band, they were using the bands out of every band, all of Brad's bands.

ctx.x: They were cleaning up. They were double dipping. That's right. I guess I could just change the cap. That's all. Just change the cap. That's all. All right. Oh, well, you know.
Just like the Eureka band, they were using the bands out of every band, all of Brad's bands. They didn't have too many bands left out of that band.
What happened to the Eureka? Anything?
